versions.content: Semantics of DiagnosticEventPortMapping A Diagnos- ticEventPortMapping defines which SwcServiceDependency s of a Atomic- SwComponentType or BswServiceDependency of a BswModuleDescription have to be connected to which DiagnosticEvent . This is realized by defining a DiagnosticEventPortMapping referencing a Diag- nosticEvent and (using instanceRef ) an instance of SwcServiceDepen- dency (or BswServiceDependency ).
